summary: Specifies how to translate the body of a message between X.400 and RFC 822 mail. It complements RFC 1327, which covers translation of the envelope and headers. It was replaced by RFC 2156.

eli5.summary: A letter has an envelope and a page inside. Another memo converts the envelope, and this one converts what is written on the page.

questions: map x.400 message body to rfc 822
x.400 and internet mail gateway body conversion
